The land interaction commenced as the sheared cloud mass associated with the cyclonic storm ‘Akvan’ entered into the north Andhra Pradesh-south Odisha coasts early on Friday, says the India Meteorological Department (IMD). “Latest satellite imagery indicates the land interaction commenced as the sheared cloud mass associated with the Cyclonic Storm ‘Akvan’ entered into the north Andhra Pradesh-south Odisha coasts,” informed IMD on Friday (November 20, 2026).
Justice Yashwant Varma has contended that proceedings for his removal as a High Court judge became infructuous following his resignation and cannot be continued, saying any attempt to remove him from office would be without constitutional foundation. In a letter dated September 10 to Lok Sabha Secretary General Utpal Kumar Singh, he responded to the report of the inquiry committee constituted by Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla. He reiterated that he was innocent of the allegations against him, including the suggestion that he possessed ill-gotten funds, and asserted that his resignation should not be construed as an acknowledgement or admission of any allegation or finding.
The number of active Rafale fighter jets in the Indian Air Force (IAF) inventory has been revised downward to 32 from 35 in the latest edition of the World Air Forces directory released by British aviation publication FlightGlobal. However, sources in the Ministry of Defence (MoD) questioned the authenticity of the assessment, saying the information was not provided by the Ministry .
The Supreme Court on Thursday (November 19, 2026) urged deleted voters to rigorously test the Election Commission of India (ECI)’s assurances that no elector, mistakenly branded ‘absent, shifted, deceased, duplicate’ or ASDD, will be left out of the electoral roll during the special enumeration phase of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR). The court said voters can hold the ECI to account only by first acting on every opportunity thrown at them by the poll body before the special enumeration phase concludes on November 30.
The Supreme Court on Thursday (November 19, 2026) directed authorities to verify allegations that fabricated Form-7s were filed to delete genuine voters from electoral rolls in Delhi’s Mustafabad Assembly Constituency during the ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process and take all remedial measures. A Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant even urged Congress leader Ali Mehdi, represented by advocate Shariq Ahmed, to approach the jurisdictional magistrate if the police have refused to register an FIR on his complaint about fabrication and forgery.
India and Japan on Thursday (November 19, 2026) held a “two-plus-two” Foreign and Defence Ministers’ dialogue in Tokyo, where the two sides welcomed the signing of a Letter of Intent (LoI) that will, for the first time, allow Japan’s Self-Defence Forces to use Indian test ranges for “live-fire training..., including those involving surface-to-ship missiles”. The two sides also indicated forward movement towards India receiving the Unified Complex Radio Antenna, or UNICORN, naval radar system from Japan, and discussed the ongoing revisions in Japan’s national security and defence policies.
The Multi-Agency Centre (MAC), a centralised intelligence-sharing platform, now tracks cybersecurity, narcotics, organised crime networks, and emerging radicalisation hotspots, Union Home Minister Amit Shah said on Thursday (November 19, 2026). The MAC, which also acts as a common counter-terrorism grid and functions under the Intelligence Bureau (IB), was conceptualised in 2001, in the aftermath of the Kargil war, but became fully operational in 2009.
Justice B.V. Nagarathna, one of the most senior judges of the Supreme Court and in line to be the first woman Chief Justice of India, has said that the mere existence of women in high public office does not establish that equality has been achieved throughout society. “A woman may hold a senior position while other women remain excluded from education, employment, property, or effective legal remedies,” Justice Nagarathna said at the inaugural Cornelia Sorabji Memorial Lecture at Somerville College in the University of Oxford.
Anthropic shares closed 17% higher in their record Nasdaq debut on Thursday (November 19, 2026), defying a broad Wall Street sell-off as investors shrugged off the Nvidia spy scandal and fears of a tech bubble to back the AI giant. The shares ended at around $97, up from the $83 at which the company priced its shares on Wednesday, already above its expected range.
The latest iteration of the COP 31 draft cover text has eliminated references to fossil fuel phase-out and net-zero dates but has also deleted references to a firm $120 billion adaptation-finance target that developing countries have been asking for as “legally binding financial obligations” on developed countries. This suggests that the most ambitious demands of both the developed and developing country blocs have been eliminated.
Pakistani security forces acting on intelligence raided militant hideouts in the northwest near the Afghan border, setting off gunbattles that killed 22 militants , the military said Thursday (November 19, 2026). It alleged that the militants killed were backed by India. There was no immediate comment from New Delhi, but Pakistan often accuses Afghanistan and India of supporting the Pakistani Taliban and other militant groups, allegations both countries deny.
Israel’s military said that a ground operation involving tanks in central Gaza that began the previous day despite a U.S.-brokered ceasefire had come to an end on Thursday (November 19, 2026). “The operation is completed,” the military told AFP . Hamas denounced a “blatant ceasefire violation,” while the military said the rare ground incursion was a response to Hamas ceasefire violations in the area.
